reading_note: A sequence of ten constructive works performed by the operative power of divine truth (the "Great Builder" = Living Spirit) within the captive states of self-love. The arc: divine truth descends into the disordered natural mind where good and truth lie imprisoned among the ruling falsities, and there it builds an ordered apparatus — vessels of reception in the heavens, wheels of cyclic purification, gates that open inward toward influx, the separation of day from night (truth from falsity), the falling out of stillborn affections, and the establishment of bounded zones — by which the light scattered through the lower mind is gathered and returned. Each numbered "because" names a reason for one work; together they constitute the whole order of redemption operating within the captive archons of the natural mind.
